critic.fix_suggestion: Duplicate the engine geometry on the opposite wing to achieve a 2x count (4 total). For each set, apply a translation of +15% aft and +10% outward from the fuselage centerline. Simultaneously, rotate the main wing geometry -30 degrees backward around its root axis to establish the required sweep angle, and parent the engine geometries to new pylon primitives attached to the underside of these swept wings.

discrepancies.observed: Two engines visible under the wing

discrepancies.reference: Engines are mounted further aft along the swept wings

discrepancies.observed: Wings appear relatively straight with minimal backward angle
discrepancies.reference: Significant rearward sweep of the main wing
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: rotate wing geometry backward around root
